notes.title: New update! Bug fixes 15/4/2018
notes.content:
Minx played my game. This makes me pretty happy but she found some bugs I didn't know about. It seems that the cause of some of them were kate's double wield ability in the last area, so I've removed it. 

This script is a pain to work with. I had to remove my favourite puzzle in the game before release because the hookshot script couldn't handle it.

People have been asking for sequels, but I currently don't have any good ideas for one. Still, I'd like to hone my sense of humor to make you all laugh in future.

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
This version adds some extra jokes to the game. The paintings in the casino gallery can now be examined.

Also, by popular request I figured out how to add a load option to the in game menu. Which has already lead one let's player to accidentally load when they intended to save. Excellent!

Also changed the front door to look more like a front door after people got stuck repeatedly getting the new bad ending by going back to bed after receiving the invitation.

notes.title: That was A nice nap!
notes.content:
Just uploaded a new version of the game. Various bugfixes that slipped through the net while testing earlier today. 

Fixed achievement calls, 3 of them were wrong.

Changed dialogue from previous version where you didn't get the Hero Sword until the end.

Reworked the special death event so it doesnt crash, it confuses me because dying to bombs doesn't crash the game, but dying to hp=0 or calling game over does.

Fixed various textboxes.

Re-added the script that moves the battler portraits down. 



I hope you enjoy the game.


Round 2! Fight!
Fixed the ending gate and the wisdom dungeon.
Reverted to just Fight and Escape on the battle screen.
